about.title: Personal, not anonymous.
about.intro: semanu is an AI-first digital partner for SMEs in Europe. We build integrated business software: one application with the functions you need, such as quotes, orders, planning, production, invoicing and customer management. What already works well today stays in place, such as your accounting, webshop or mailbox. We connect it so that your entire ecosystem communicates. We also build 3D configurators that let your customers configure their product themselves.
about.missionText: Today SMEs have to choose between standard software that never quite fits and custom software that is too expensive and too slow. We believe that choice is no longer necessary. SMEs deserve the same digital strength as large companies, without long projects or big budgets.
about.saasTitle: Custom software with the ease of SaaS
about.saasText: You get software that follows how your business works, not the other way round. Yet it feels like a subscription. We host the software on a dedicated European server and keep it secure and up to date. You pay a fixed amount per month. You start with the module that adds the most value today. As your business grows, the software grows along: extra modules, users or integrations without starting over.
about.visionText: We want no SME in Europe to fall behind because custom software is too expensive or too slow. AI is changing how software is made. What only multinationals could afford before is now within reach of every company. semanu wants to be the leading partner in Europe for SMEs that want to work AI-first. AI does the work. People stay in control.

principles.title: Personal
principles.text: You talk directly to the person who builds your solution.

principles.title: Integrated
principles.text: We connect to what already works instead of replacing everything.

principles.title: Affordable and predictable
principles.text: A fixed monthly amount instead of a large project up front.

principles.title: Scalable
principles.text: You expand module by module when you are ready.

principles.title: Honest about AI
principles.text: We use AI where it helps. When it does not, we tell you.

principles.title: No lock-in
principles.text: You receive the full source code and a perpetual right of use. You can always continue without us.

about.founderText: semanu is led by Tom de Vree and is based in Antwerp, Belgium. We work personally with SMEs and manufacturers across Europe. You talk directly to the person who builds your solution.
